_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); seed and crop protection signals

pit_profile.why: Corteva: 'The company competes with producers of seed germplasm, trait developers, and crop protection products on a global basis.'; the FY2022 10-K's risk factors: 'Climate change and unpredictable seasonal and weather factors could impact Corteva’s sales and earnings.'; no disruption theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining), so the weather and climate wording stays here

classification.quality_note: Corteva: 'The company competes with producers of seed germplasm, trait developers, and crop protection products on a global basis.'; the FY2022 10-K's risk factors: 'Climate change and unpredictable seasonal and weather factors could impact Corteva’s sales and earnings.'; no disruption theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining), so the weather and climate wording stays here. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.28x; +55% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.06; conservative 2yr -15%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -32.0%/yr (worst year FY20-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.4%/yr (FY23 net sales guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.1-yr ex-FY19 median

BULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (FY20-FY22 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY20-FY22, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CTVA (retrospective, 2023-02-24) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.28x (77.3% downside to Bear $14 / +60.5% upside to Bull $99) | Adj composite 2.54 vs market 2.60: gap -0.06 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +55% above the EPP floor $40 (24x FY23E $1.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: -14.6% total (-7.3%/yr) | At 37.2x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $82 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Seed organic +18.0% and Crop Protection organic +7.0% in Q4 2022, forward revenues +3.7-5.4% (FY2023 net sales guide $18.1-18.4B (Q4 2022 release) on FY22 $17.455B, no Q1 2023 guide); no theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining); none has dated evidence.
